description: Per-run token usage for the SIFT-Bench reference agent, derived from committed Claude Code session transcripts.
source: Claude Code session transcripts (~/.claude/projects/<project>/*.jsonl), copied verbatim into cases/srl-2018/session_transcripts/_raw/.
derivation: Sum of the per-assistant-turn `usage` objects across each committed transcript (input + output + cache_creation + cache_read).
granularity: Per assistant turn. Token counts are NOT recorded per tool call, so finding->tool token attribution is not available.
execution_log_note: Token usage is not present in the per-run execution_log.json artifacts; it exists only in the session transcript.
run6_note: The Run 6 agent-run session transcript was NOT retained (Claude Code session rotation; ~/.claude/.last-cleanup = 2026-06-13). A Run 6 token total is therefore not recoverable. The figures below are Run 4 and Run 5 — the same SRL-2018 agent workflow, different runs — offered as representative scale, not as Run 6 values.
